body:
Source: GitHub issue #712 (release-audit class false-green, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ 7f45efd5: `packages/preflight/lib/runner.mjs:53` gates the test-cmd check on plain truthiness (`if (opts.testCmd)`), and `packages/preflight/bin/preflight.mjs` passes `flags['test-cmd']` straight through. `node packages/preflight/bin/preflight.mjs --test-cmd "" --json` prints a 4-row pass (bash, git, write, branch), verdict `pass`, exit 0 — the user explicitly requested a check, it silently did not run, and the tool reported success. This is exactly what `preflight --test-cmd "$TEST_CMD"` produces in CI when the variable is unset. The README (line ~75) says a passed flag makes its check required, which is false for an empty value.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/preflight`: bin/preflight.mjs (parseArgs from @adlc/core; catches thrown errors as `error: preflight internal error: …` exit 1; exits 2 on a failed verdict), lib/runner.mjs (`runChecks(opts)` returns rows `{name,status,detail,required}`), lib/checks.mjs (`checkTestCmd(cmd, cwd)` runs the command via sh), lib/render.mjs. Tests: test/unit.test.mjs and test/integration.test.mjs, run with `npm test -w packages/preflight`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Distinguish flag ABSENT from flag PRESENT-BUT-EMPTY. In lib/runner.mjs: when `opts.testCmd !== undefined`, the value must be a string with non-whitespace content; otherwise `runChecks` rejects with an Error whose message contains `--test-cmd requires a non-empty command`. An absent `testCmd` keeps today's behaviour (no test-cmd row).
2. In bin/preflight.mjs, validate the flag BEFORE calling runChecks and print `error: --test-cmd requires a non-empty command (received an empty value); pass a command or omit the flag` to stderr, exit 1. The lib guard in (1) stays as the API's own defense — the bin must not report this case as an "internal error". Put the emptiness predicate in ONE exported helper used by both the bin and runChecks (so a mutation of either call site is caught).
3. With `--json` and an empty `--test-cmd`, print NOTHING on stdout (no verdict document) — the error goes to stderr and the exit is 1.
4. Documentation: update `packages/preflight/README.md` (flag table row for `--test-cmd` and the sentence about passed flags becoming required) to state that a passed-but-empty `--test-cmd` is rejected with exit 1, and make the SAME edit by hand in the mirrors `docs/tools/preflight.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/preflight.mdx` (hand-maintained — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `node packages/preflight/bin/preflight.mjs --test-cmd ""` exits 1, stderr contains `--test-cmd requires a non-empty command`, stdout is empty. verify: `node --test packages/preflight/test/empty-test-cmd.test.mjs`
- AC2 `--test-cmd "   "` (whitespace only) behaves as AC1; `--test-cmd "" --json` exits 1 with EMPTY stdout. verify: `node --test packages/preflight/test/empty-test-cmd.test.mjs`
- AC3 `runChecks({ cwd, testCmd: '' })` rejects with /non-empty command/; `runChecks({ cwd })` resolves with exactly the four required rows bash, git, write, branch (unchanged). verify: `node --test packages/preflight/test/empty-test-cmd.test.mjs`
- AC4 Regression: `--test-cmd "true"` prints a `test-cmd` row with PASS and exits 0; `--test-cmd "false"` prints a `test-cmd` FAIL row and exits 2. verify: `node --test packages/preflight/test/empty-test-cmd.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/preflight`
- AC6 Docs updated in all three places. verify: `grep -c "non-empty" packages/preflight/README.md docs/tools/preflight.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/preflight.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)

BUILD CONSTRAINTS. Work only in the assigned worktree. The rails listed on this ticket are frozen for the build — if the fix appears to require editing a rail path, stop and report; never set ADLC_RAILS_BYPASS. TDD: write test/empty-test-cmd.test.mjs first, confirm it fails, then implement. The package suite (`npm test -w packages/preflight`) and the mutation gate (`node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`) must exit 0 before the change is proposed for merge. Do not add gate-manifest entries. Keep the diff to packages/preflight/**, the three docs files, and this ticket's shard. The PR closes #712.
title: preflight: reject a present-but-empty --test-cmd (exit 1) instead of silently skipping the check and passing
